Container.Name: Cratekeep
Container.Overview: Cratekeep is a lightweight web interface for managing a beets music library. Review MusicBrainz matches, import music from an inbox, and edit metadata and file tags.[br][br]First run: select /data/inbox and /data/library in the setup screen. Configuration, databases, and the generated signing key persist in /data/config.[br][br]Imports move files from the inbox to the library and can write reviewed tags. Start with disposable copies. Both media mounts must be writable.[br][br]Cratekeep has no built-in authentication. Use a trusted network or an authenticating reverse proxy; do not expose it directly to the internet.[br][br]Runs as Unraid nobody:users (99:100). Ensure all mapped folders are writable by this user, or adjust --user in Extra Parameters.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: beets musicbrainz music library metadata tagging import

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Cratekeep web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, SQLite databases, beets configuration, and generated signing key. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: Inbox
Config.Description: Choose your incoming music folder. Imports move files out of this folder. Must be writable and separate from the Library folder; neither may contain the other.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Choose your destination music library. Cratekeep can move files here and write reviewed tags. Start with disposable copies. Must be writable and separate from Inbox.
